32b3c9b3-9bc5-5e47-8929-e259404bec38.title: Two dangerous wounds
32b3c9b3-9bc5-5e47-8929-e259404bec38.content:
"I myself received a very dangerous wound on the 9th day of July in 1605 at around 8:24 in the evening"

Morin, Astrologia Gallica, Book 24, tr. James Herschel Holden, p. 65

f19d8001-4cfd-50b6-9d03-10dadf6f7914.title: Fever at the eclipse
f19d8001-4cfd-50b6-9d03-10dadf6f7914.content:
"during an eclipse that occurred on the 30th of May, I fell into a continuous fever on that very day"

Morin, Astrologia Gallica, Book 23, tr. James Herschel Holden, 2nd ed., p. 40

d230f458-e829-5c8f-b2c3-3205e5b3d934.title: Doctor of Medicine
d230f458-e829-5c8f-b2c3-3205e5b3d934.content:
"I received the Doctor of Medicine degree at Avignon on the 9th of May"

Morin, Astrologia Gallica, Book 23, tr. James Herschel Holden, 2nd ed., p. 42

87197f8e-1613-5d75-80bd-43fa265f885d.title: Near drowning in the Rhine
87197f8e-1613-5d75-80bd-43fa265f885d.content:
"On the 7th day of July in 1615 around 10:20 in the evening, I underwent the greatest danger of dying and drowning in the Rhine"

Morin, Astrologia Gallica, Book 24, tr. James Herschel Holden, p. 66

df6ae560-8d4b-5d84-944a-8883ace81e06.title: Fall from horse
df6ae560-8d4b-5d84-944a-8883ace81e06.content:
"On the 1st of January 1616 at around 2 PM I underwent a terrible, near fatal danger from a fall from my horse"

Morin, Astrologia Gallica, Book 24, tr. James Herschel Holden, p. 68

f72d554a-c416-56f8-8a02-e55ca512cb21.title: Malign illness
f72d554a-c416-56f8-8a02-e55ca512cb21.content:
"a great, malign, and lengthy illness befell me on the 16th day of April 1616"

Morin, Astrologia Gallica, Book 23, tr. James Herschel Holden, 2nd ed., p. 45

09d2b9b3-17aa-50f5-a19f-05cc2fa5698b.title: Royal professorship granted
09d2b9b3-17aa-50f5-a19f-05cc2fa5698b.content:
"obtained on the 3rd of August 1629 an appointment by King Louis XIII"

Morin, Astrologia Gallica, Book 23, tr. James Herschel Holden, 2nd ed., p. 81

f369d32e-1e13-54d1-a9bd-5e497841a694.title: Professorship received
f369d32e-1e13-54d1-a9bd-5e497841a694.content:
"I was given the dignity of Regius Professor of Mathematics, and I received it on the 4th day of September."

Morin, Astrologia Gallica, Book 23, tr. James Herschel Holden, 2nd ed., p. 99

24848901-3dea-54bf-9c8a-5307a2ddfd03.title: Longitude demonstration
24848901-3dea-54bf-9c8a-5307a2ddfd03.content:
"In the year 1634 on the 30th of March, I publicly demonstrated the science of longitudes"

Morin, Astrologia Gallica, Book 23, tr. James Herschel Holden, 2nd ed., p. 99

b3a60977-ef57-501f-bd46-ba8135bf340e.title: Fever with rigor
b3a60977-ef57-501f-bd46-ba8135bf340e.content:
"On the 2nd of November 1642 around noon I was seized by a fever along with a rigor"

Morin, Astrologia Gallica, Book 24, tr. James Herschel Holden, p. 68

bda626d3-126f-5a67-bc37-6e0195b1322d.title: Pension awarded
bda626d3-126f-5a67-bc37-6e0195b1322d.content:
"In the year 1645 on the 8th of April, I was awarded by the Royal Council a pension of 2,000 livres"

Morin, Astrologia Gallica, Book 23, tr. James Herschel Holden, 2nd ed., p. 100

c7847139-03ab-50a9-90e6-f25ad51d118a.title: Departs Paris for Antibes
c7847139-03ab-50a9-90e6-f25ad51d118a.content:
"I elected 7:09 AM of 9 May."

Morin, Astrologia Gallica, Book 26, tr. James Herschel Holden, p. 79

da0d0053-c2fc-54fe-95ea-dc2a77099380.title: Departs Antibes
da0d0053-c2fc-54fe-95ea-dc2a77099380.content:
"I elected 4:27 AM on July 2nd."

Morin, Astrologia Gallica, Book 26, tr. James Herschel Holden, p. 87

8409bd6d-75c0-5f4e-9802-6cdd03ab4041.title: Fever after the eclipse
8409bd6d-75c0-5f4e-9802-6cdd03ab4041.content:
"a rigor and a fever with a fierce catarrh suddenly coming upon me"

Morin, Astrologia Gallica, Book 22, tr. James Herschel Holden, 2nd ed., p. 42
